content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Boston

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and documented project-management experience. Review PMI's specific hour requirements for your educational background, then gather evidence of your professional project leadership. Granite PM Academy's enrollment team can help you verify you meet the credential prerequisites before you enroll.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP course delivered entirely online. Attend interactive sessions at your own pace over weeks or months, gaining in-depth coverage of the PMBOK® Guide and real-world project scenarios. All instruction happens via secure video conferencing—no travel required, full flexibility for your Boston-area work schedule.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing your contact hours, file your formal PMP application directly with PMI, detailing your education and project experience. Pay PMI's examination fee at the time of submission. Granite PM Academy provides guidance through the application process to ensure accuracy and timely approval.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice tests, study guides, and review sessions led by active certified practitioners. Schedule your exam through PMI's testing partner at a time and location convenient to you. Granite PM Academy's support extends through your test day to maximize your confidence and readiness.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: After earning your PMP, commit to earning professional development units (PDUs) over the standard three-year renewal cycle. Attend training, conferences, and volunteering activities recognized by PMI. Granite PM Academy offers ongoing PDU-eligible courses to support your continuous learning and credential maintenance.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI sets four eligibility paths based on education: a secondary diploma (high school or equivalent) requires 60 months of project leadership experience; an associate's degree requires 48 months; a bachelor's degree requires 36 months; and a bachelor's or postgraduate degree from a PMI Global Accreditation Center (GAC)-accredited program requires just 24 months. Every path also requires 35 hours of project management education — our course satisfies this requirement in full.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.

fq_items.question: Is this training PMI-approved?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Granite PM Academy is a PMI Premier Authorized Training Partner (ATP). Our curriculum is aligned to PMI’s current Examination Content Outline and our contact hours are fully accepted by PMI.
